The `allow_permission` decorator at line 1094 only verifies that the caller is an ADMIN or MEMBER of the project referenced in the URL (`project_id`), but does NOT restrict which issues can be updated. There is no check that any of those issue IDs belong to the same project (`project_id`) or workspace (`slug`) as the calling user. An authenticated project member could supply arbitrary UUIDs from other projects or workspaces and forge cross-project/cross-workspace issue relations. The existing `ProjectEntityPermission` only verifies the caller is a member of the target project; it does not validate that the referenced `issue` objects in the `issues` list belong to that same project.
